title: Identity compactification recovers direct image
statement:
If $f$ is proper, the identity compactification identifies $Rf_!^{(1,f)}$
with $Rf_*$, makes $\theta_1$ the identity, and identifies the compactified
formula with $\pi_{f,E,Q}$ and its inverse with $\rho_{f,E,Q}$.

proof.text: Choose the identity coefficient identification by conjugating the canonical sheaf pushforward identity isomorphism across the sheaf adjunction. The conjugate-unit equation identifies its adjoint ring map with the inverse pushforward identity. Applying the functor isomorphism to module pushforward and then the module pushforward identity gives identityModulePushforward. Left-adjoint uniqueness gives the identity module pullback; mapping this isomorphism to derived categories gives identityDerivedPullback. Left-adjoint uniqueness for the exact derived open adjunction now gives identityDerivedOpenExtension. All these are explicit isomorphisms built from Mathlib adjunction and functor identity APIs; no witness of an arbitrary existence theorem is chosen.

proof.text: Apply proEtaleProjectionFormula_compactified to Compactification.ofIsProper f, with the same coefficient ring S and tensor model on the intermediate scheme X, and with the identity coefficient identification from step 1. Its hπ gives invertibility of the canonical projection mate at j_!E. Let e : j_!E ≅ E be step 1. First-variable naturality identifies pi(j_!E) followed by Rf_*(e tensor 1) with (Rf_*e tensor 1) followed by pi(E). The left composite is invertible. The first factor of the right composite is invertible, so cancellation proves mate_isIso at E. This uses arbitrary unbounded E and site-perfect Q without a global bound.

proof.text: In the normalized identity-open presentation, directImage is identity followed by Rf_*, so Functor.leftUnitor supplies its isomorphism with Rf_*. The definition theta is the identity. Unfold forward and theta and use Functor.map_id and Category.comp_id to obtain pi. Unfold backward and use Functor.map_id and Category.id_comp to obtain rho, the unique inverse supplied by mate_isIso. These prove the four conjuncts of identity_compactification without changing any statement or definition.

lean.note: No declaration had been recorded for this dependency.
